text:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'eu-west-1/gpu-pool-3' > 95% utilization, queue length spiked x12 in 6m. Autoscaler reported repeated scale failures (rate-limit, provider quota). Severity: P1.
maya (oncall): acked. I'm on it, joining bridge in 2m. Paging @chris @eng-sre.
chris: seeing backlog, many small requests piling up due to long-tail KV cache misses. Latency for text-generation endpoints > 4s for ~30% of requests.
eng-sre: I'm on the bridge. Autoscaler logs show 429 from provider at scale attempt time 17:14:32, then backoff loop.
lia: customer-facing: two enterprise customers reported 503 spikes, others elevated latency. Opening an incident status page now.
maya (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable evict-heavy-tenant policy to shed large jobs 2) force-upscale to standby reserved pool 3) enable model-fallback (smaller variant) on hosted API routes.
chris: rolling out model-fallback on /v1/generate for low-priority tenants now. Patch command: ```redctl route update --route /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood/small-1 --constraint low-prio```
infra-bot: runbook step executed: routed 18% of traffic to fallback variant.
eng-sre: tried manual scale via provider console, quota blocked. Provider returned "quota_exceeded" for requested GPUs. We can only use existing reserved warm pools.
maya (oncall): force-drain non-critical batches and pause scheduled evictions. Command: ```rctl pool drain --pool gpu-pool-3 --filter tenant:non-critical```. Executing.
chris: draining 3 large batch jobs freed ~6 GPUs, queue length dropped 40%. Customer errors improving.
lia: status update posted: "Partial degradation — some requests delayed, mitigation in progress. No data loss." Sent to customers affected.
eng-sre: autoscaler backoff is coming from our retry loop hitting max retries; looks like a regression from last autoscaler change. Reproducing locally.
maya (oncall): handing off to eng-sre lead @chris for midnight shift monitoring. I'll stay for postmortem. Scheduled follow-up 2h.
chris: noted. Action items so far: 1) revert faulty autoscaler retry patch 2) add headroom config (x1.2) to EU pools 3) provider quota request (emergency) 4) update runbook to include forced-drain steps.
eng-sre: adding task to repo: "autoscaler: limit exponential backoff cap and surfaced error codes". Assigning to @chris.
lia: customers on status page acknowledged, SLA alerting updated. No escalations to execs so far.
maya (oncall): incident declared resolved at 17:48 after queue returned to normal and error rate <1% sustained for 10m. Postmortem owner: maya. Please add timeline entries and logs to the incident doc.
chris: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = provider quota constraint combined with recent autoscaler retry change that prevented graceful fallback to warm pools.
eng-sre: temporary mitigations worked; long-term: (a) add soft cap headroom, (b) auto-fallback to smaller models when scale fails, (c) provider quota alerting, (d) revert or fix retry regression.
lia: tagging impacted customers and scheduling customer follow-up email.
maya (oncall): thanks team. I'll create the postmortem ticket and link runbook updates. :thumbsup:
